channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Dani Lima: Empréstimo de amiga de Lulinha deixa Lula com gosto de traição
item.description: Columnist Dani Lima states that the loan received by Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, from Roberta Luchsinger — a friend of Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva (Lulinha) — left President Lula with a feeling of betrayal. According to her, Lula was left with 'a very bitter taste in the mouth of betrayal'.

item.title: União Brasil oficializa neutralidade e não vai apoiar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: União Brasil declared neutrality in the 2026 presidential elections, allowing its members to support candidates based on state-level scenarios. The decision, made at a national convention, reinforces the federation’s independence from the Progressistas and avoids endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The party also authorized its national executive to adjust majoritarian tickets until the candidacy registration deadline.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda governo retirar publicações que promovem Lula
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the federal government to remove, within 48 hours, official publications promoting President Lula’s personal actions, deeming them inappropriate institutional propaganda. The ruling aims to prevent the use of public resources for electoral purposes, ensuring fairness ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Kassio aponta propaganda velada e manda governo remover conteúdos de canais oficiais em 24 horas
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the Presidency to remove within 24 hours any official content constituting veiled institutional publicity that highlights President Lula. The ruling aims to ensure electoral fairness in 2026 by preventing the use of public resources for personal promotion. The decision was issued on April 8, 2026, at 5:13 PM.

item.title: Mulher de Weverton recebeu R$ 11 mi de advogado, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA) for allegedly coordinating illegal payments related to undue discounts in INSS pensions and retirements. His wife, Samya Lorene de Oliveira Bernardes Rocha, allegedly received R$11 million from lawyer Willer Tomaz, used as an alternative account to move funds. Operation Sem Desconto, authorized by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, executed 18 search and seizure warrants in the Federal District and Maranhão.

item.title: União Brasil confirma neutralidade nas eleições
item.description: União Brasil confirmed neutrality in the 2026 presidential elections, following the stance of the Progressistas Party (PP), with which it forms a federation. The decision rules out the possibility of Senator Tereza Cristina being the running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), as PP had previously declared neutrality on Friday. Republicanos also announced neutrality on Tuesday, undermining PL’s efforts to consolidate support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy.

item.title: Democrata oficializa candidatos para as eleições de 2026 e confirma apoio à reeleição de Tarcísio
item.description: The Democratic Party officially nominated its slate for the 2026 elections, fielding 28 candidates for state deputy and 32 for federal deputy in an online convention held in São Paulo. The party confirmed its support for the re-election of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) and will not run a Senate candidate.

item.title: Assessor de Lula que recebeu dinheiro de lobista tinha salário de elite no governo
item.description: Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, former chief of staff to Lula and advisor to the PT campaign, received money from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who is under investigation for INSS fraud. Although he claims the amount was a repaid loan, his June net salary was R$ 47,377, plus allowances and jeton payments, reflecting an elite government income. The Federal Police is investigating the truth of his claim, while PT allies criticize his acceptance of funds from lobbyists.

item.title: Crusoé: Renan Santos defende intervenção federal no Rio
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate of the Missão party, stated he would support federal intervention in Rio de Janeiro to combat organized crime if elected president. He criticized the administration of current mayor Eduardo Paes (PSD), saying he cannot imagine a scenario where crime is effectively addressed under Paes's leadership. The remarks were made in an exclusive interview with O Antagonista and Crusoé following a joint interview by OA and G4.

item.title: Moraes quer parecer da PGR sobre visitas políticas a Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has given the PGR a 5-day deadline to rule on Jair Bolsonaro's appeal against the ban on political visits. Bolsonaro's defense argues the measure violates freedom of thought and expression, citing the Lula case in 2018 as a precedent. Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years and 3 months for a coup plot, is serving his sentence under house arrest after surgery.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest testa disputa Lula x Flávio, com perguntas sobre choque de Milei e caso Michelle
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll will test how international and domestic factors influence the 2026 presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, including Javier Milei’s endorsement, the public reconciliation between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro, Alexandre de Moraes’ rulings, and perceptions of potential Trump support. The survey also covers electronic voting machines, AI in campaign materials, and Lula’s government approval, based on 2,004 in-person interviews conducted from July 31 to August 3.

item.title: Podemos opta por neutralidade e frustra plano de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Podemos has decided to remain neutral in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, terminating negotiations with Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign and undermining the PL's strategy to broaden its coalition before the party convention deadline. The decision, expected to be announced by the party's national executive on Tuesday (August 4), leaves Bolsonaro isolated in the presidential race, reduces his access to free electoral advertising time on radio and TV, and leaves the vice-presidential candidate choice undefined.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio troca “bolsa celular” por cashback
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s presidential candidate, revised his proposal to distribute free cell phones to women and the elderly, replacing it with a cashback program. The adjustment was made during an interview with O Antagonista and G4, but was criticized as being worse than the original idea.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB lançará livro sobre recusa a golpe de Estado
item.description: Lieutenant Brigadier Carlos de Almeida Baptista Junior, former commander of the Brazilian Air Force (FAB), will release in September the book 'EU DISSE NÃO! Uma trincheira antigolpista', recounting his refusal to join a coup attempt during Bolsonaro's government. Baptista Junior served as a witness for the PGR in the criminal action that led to the conviction of the former president and other members of the core coup group, stating he resisted pressures for institutional rupture. The book covers the period from 2019 to 2023, including pandemic management, the 2021 military crisis, and the 2022 electoral tensions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro não quer saber de pandemia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided commenting on the coronavirus pandemic controversies that have been circulating in Bolsonarist social media, despite the release of Anthony Fauci’s diary and criticisms from allies like Eduardo Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira. His silence contrasts with the active engagement of other family members and aligned lawmakers on the issue.

item.title: Crusoé: Metade dos eleitores não vê motivo para votar em Flávio
item.description: Half of Brazilian voters (50%) see no reason to support Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential elections, according to a Realtime Big Data poll published by O Antagonista. Meanwhile, 27% believe he is the only candidate capable of defeating President Lula, and 16% would vote for him based on Jair Bolsonaro's endorsement. Only 7% provided other unspecified reasons for their support.

item.title: Quem é Marcola, ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula investigado pela PF
item.description: Marcola, former chief of staff to President Lula, was removed from office after a PF investigation revealed payments received from businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha, the president’s son. He denied any wrongdoing, stating the funds were a personal loan already repaid. The PF is investigating a possible influence-peddling scheme involving Lulinha, lobbyists, and businessmen seeking federal contracts.

item.title: Moraes dá cinco dias para PGR opinar sobre recursos de Bolsonaro contra restrições políticas e suspensão de visitas de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has given the Prosecutor General's Office five days to respond to appeals by Jair Bolsonaro's defense against political restrictions imposed during the 2026 elections. The restrictions ban visits for political-partisan purposes and suspend Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's visits for 90 days after a handwritten letter was shared on social media. The defense argues the measures violate free speech, are vague and disproportionate, citing Lula's 2018 precedent and claiming interference with attorney-client privileges.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que definição sobre vice sairá até o dia 15 de agosto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, said he will announce his running mate by August 15, the deadline for candidacy registration. He publicly endorsed Daniella Marques, former head of Caixa Econômica Federal, as his preferred vice-presidential pick, praising her economic and leadership qualities during Bolsonaro’s administration. He downplayed the lack of formal support from center and right-wing parties, claiming the PP remains aligned with him despite its national neutrality.

item.title: PSB rejeita vice de Patrus e amplia dificuldade do PT em Minas
item.description: The PSB rejected the proposal to join Patrus Ananias’s (PT) gubernatorial ticket as vice-presidential candidate in Minas Gerais, instead backing Jarbas Soares Júnior for the Senate. This complicates the PT’s efforts to form a complete ticket, as Lula had advocated for Josué Gomes (PSB) as vice. The final candidate definitions will be made at a convention in Belo Horizonte on Wednesday, August 5, 2026.

item.title: Eleitorado neste ano vai às urnas ressentido
item.description: The 2026 electorate is heading to the polls resentful, reflecting a context in which electoral victories depend on popular support, partisan backing, and the ability to exploit opponents' mistakes. The article cites Tancredo Neves' 1985 election as a historical example of how these factors contributed to Brazil's democratic transition.

item.title: Moraes pede que PGR se manifeste sobre recursos da defesa de Bolsonaro contra proibição de visitas de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has asked the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to rule on appeals by Bolsonaro's defense against the ban on visits from Flávio Bolsonaro, which was imposed after the senator shared a handwritten letter from the former president endorsing his presidential pre-candidacy on social media. The defense claims the measure is disproportionate and violates penal execution law and international human rights treaties, while Moraes maintains the 90-day suspension, citing misuse of visitation rights and violation of the social media ban.

item.title: Moraes manda PGR opinar sobre pedido para liberar visita de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has given the Prosecutor General's Office a five-day deadline to rule on appeals by Jair Bolsonaro's defense against two decisions that suspended his access to certain benefits for 90 days. The request concerns granting permission for Flávio Bolsonaro to visit Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Damares declara apoio à candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos) declared her support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential candidacy, despite her party's decision to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential election. She made the announcement immediately after the Republicanos party convention, where it was decided that the party would not endorse any presidential candidate.

item.title: O empréstimo da lobista para ex-assessor de Lula foi feito em um só desembolso
item.description: The loan granted by lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger to former Lula aide Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola) consisted of a single disbursement, with no installments or multiple payments. The funds were provided in one lump sum and later repaid by Marcola. The information comes from a subscriber-exclusive article.

item.title: Grupo suspeito de planejar atentados em Brasília tinha Palácio do Planalto como alvo primário
item.description: The Civil Police of the Federal District identified that a group suspected of planning attacks in Brasília during the 2026 electoral period had the Palácio do Planalto as its primary target, in addition to mapping other buildings in the Ministries Esplanade, such as the National Congress and the STF. The group, composed of eight individuals aged 19 to 31, including a seminarian, did not align with any specific political ideology, presenting itself as opposed to the political system as a whole. Investigations, initiated by an alert from Abin and conducted by Ciberlab, prioritized seizing digital devices to verify the existence of explosive devices and execution plans.

item.title: Lula manda assessor explicar empréstimo de amiga de Lulinha investigada pela PF
item.description: President Lula ordered his former chief of staff, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, to explain a loan obtained from Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of his son Lulinha who is under investigation by the Federal Police. The move aims to ensure transparency amid allegations of favoritism.

item.title: Centrais se mobilizam para ato inaugural da campanha de Lula e cobram pauta trabalhista
item.description: Trade union centrals announced the mobilization of thousands of workers for the inaugural act of President Lula's (PT) re-election campaign, scheduled for April 16 at the Vila Euclides stadium in São Bernardo do Campo. The event aims to pressure for a labor-focused agenda in the government's priorities.

item.title: Lula telefona para Putin e fala em aumento das exportações brasileiras para a Rússia
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva spoke by phone with Vladimir Putin, emphasizing the need to increase Brazilian exports to Russia, particularly diesel and fertilizers, and reinforcing the strategic nature of bilateral relations. The leaders discussed cooperation in energy, science, technology, and naval affairs, expressed concern over the UN Security Council's inability to resolve conflicts, and reaffirmed support for multilateralism and BRICS. Lula also reiterated Brazil’s backing for Michelle Bachelet’s candidacy for UN Secretary-General.

item.title: Republicanos confirma candidatura de Alexandre Curi ao Senado
item.description: The Republicans party officially confirmed, on Monday (3), the candidacy of state deputy Alexandre Curi for the Federal Senate from Paraná, during a party convention in Curitiba. The confirmation reinforces the party's strategy to strengthen its base in the state for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Testa de ferro de Lulinha celebrou indicação de Dino: "Viva a Justiça"
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, described as Lulinha's 'iron fist', celebrated Flávio Dino's 2023 STF nomination as 'the best news of the week'. Dino was later appointed rapporteur of a third investigation into Lulinha for suspected influence trafficking, tied to the INSS Careca scheme. Defenses for Lulinha and Luchsinger deny the allegations, while President Lula claims his children are targets of political attacks.

item.title: Eleições 2026: as idas e vindas de Cleitinho na disputa pelo governo de Minas Gerais
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) has vacillated in his bid for the Minas Gerais governorship in 2026, alternating between declaring candidacy and suggesting withdrawal, despite the official launch of his pre-candidacy in March. On June 4, the national president of the Republicans, Marcos Pereira, rejected Cleitinho’s final request to be the party’s candidate, maintaining the party’s neutrality in the election. Although he led polls in April, his candidacy remains uncertain due to external conditions and lack of definitive party support.

item.title: Agora cotado como vice de Aro, Falcão jura fidelidade a Cleitinho
item.description: Luiz Eduardo Falcão, former mayor of Patos de Minas and a potential running mate for Marcelo Aro in the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race, declared his continued loyalty to Senator Cleitinho Azevedo, despite the senator stating he would not run for governor. Falcão noted that Cleitinho’s family had traveled to Brasília to support a possible candidacy, underscoring his allegiance to the senator even as he may join another ticket.

item.title: DF: grupo que planejou atentado disseminava ódio a mulheres e meninas
item.description: The Federal District Civil Police (PCDF) revealed that the group suspected of planning attacks in Brasília during the 2026 elections was spreading misogynistic messages, including claims that women could not hold positions such as delegates, judges, or prosecutors. The investigation, led by the DPCev, also uncovered plans to invade public buildings, use of architectural maps and 3D models, and manuals for manufacturing explosive devices. Operation 'Rede Interrompida' led to precautionary measures against eight suspects across five states, based on technical analysis from Ciberlab, linked to the Ministry of Justice and Public Security.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha diz confiar na condução de Dino em novo inquérito
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, expressed calm regarding the opening of a third investigation against him, affirming full confidence in the conduct of Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino. The lawyers’ statement asserts that Lulinha will prove his innocence, as he did in the INSS fraud inquiry, and urges strong measures against selective and criminal leaks. The defense also accuses certain sectors of the Federal Police of acting with political and electoral bias, undermining the impartiality of criminal proceedings.

item.title: Ex-assessor de Lula foi no mínimo imprudente ao pedir dinheiro a lobista, dizem aliados
item.description: Lula's former chief of staff, Marco Aurélio Santana, nicknamed Marcola, was described by allies as at least imprudent for requesting money from a lobbyist with government interests. The incident raises concerns about ethics and transparency in the current administration. The exclusive subscriber-only article highlights the risk of conflicts of interest involving close aides to the Palácio do Planalto.

item.title: PCDF investiga suspeitos de planejar atentados no período eleitoral
item.description: The Civil Police of the Federal District launched Operation Rede Interrompida against a group investigated for planning violent actions during the 2026 elections, including sharing explosive manuals, building invasions, and target analysis in Brasília. Eight suspects aged 19 to 31 were targeted across five Brazilian states, with investigations probing charges such as criminal association, incitement to crime, and crime apology — though not yet classified under terrorism law.

item.title: “É bom o eleitor observar os partidos neutros na eleição nacional”, diz líder do PL
item.description: PL leader Sóstenes Cavalcante criticized parties choosing neutrality in the 2026 presidential race, stating it is good for voters to observe such positions. The PL's pre-candidate is Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who will face President Lula (PT). The comment was made in an interview published by O Antagonista.

item.title: União Progressista e PL terão mais tempo de propaganda eleitoral
item.description: The TSE announced the allocation of free electoral advertising time for 2026, with the União Progressista Federation (União Brasil and PP) leading at 104 federal deputies, followed by the PL with 98 and the Brasil da Esperança Federation (PT, PCdoB and PV) with 81. The free advertising period on radio and TV will run from August 28 to October 1, three days before the first round.

item.title: Podemos recusa apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro e também decide ficar neutro na eleição
item.description: Podemos rejected support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and chose to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential election. Although the PL had explored the possibility of inviting party president Deputy Renata Abreu as a running mate on the Bolsonaro ticket, Podemos ultimately declined to align with any candidate.

item.title: TSE mantém multas por doação eleitoral acima do limite e propaganda irregular em templo religioso
item.description: The TSE unanimously upheld two electoral fines: one of R$ 17,144.03 for exceeding donation limits in 2022 imposed on Fernanda Marçal Nunes Hourneaux de Moura, and another of R$ 2,000 for irregular religious temple propaganda in 2024 imposed on Fernanda Leite Carvalhaes. The Court confirmed that recording the infraction in the electoral registry is merely informational and does not cause ineligibility. The ruling underscores the TSE’s commitment to electoral equality and the prohibition of using common-use assets, such as religious temples, for campaigning.

item.title: As 3 investigações contra Lulinha autorizadas pelo STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino authorized three new investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, following requests from the Federal Police. The probes concern alleged irregularities in public contracts and abuse of influence. Fábio Luís's defense has not yet responded, while President Lula stated that if his son is accused, he will have to prove his innocence.

item.title: Renan Santos defende fim do foro privilegiado e reforma nos poderes do STF
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos advocated for reducing the power of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) and ending privileged forum, calling it a political control mechanism over lawmakers. He stated that, if elected, he would implement these reforms in a republican manner, alongside proposals for fiscal adjustment, revision of penal matters, decoupling the Continuous Benefit (BPC) from the minimum wage, and disconnecting mandatory spending, labeling Manaus’ free trade zone as 'fiscal trickery'.

item.title: Zema diz que vice 'provavelmente será do Novo' e que definição sai nesta quarta
item.description: Romeu Zema, the presidential candidate from Novo, said his running mate will likely be from his own party, forming a 'pure blood' ticket, with a decision expected by tomorrow afternoon. He avoided naming specific candidates, such as Senator Eduardo Girão, and reiterated his pledges to cut spending, reduce ministries to 22, and propose new rules for Supreme Court nominations, including a minimum age of 60 and a triple list prepared by the Senate, OAB, and STJ.

item.title: Assessor citado por repasse de amiga de Lulinha foi mensageiro de Lula na prisão; conheça
item.description: Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, former chief of staff to President Lula and his messenger during imprisonment, left the role two weeks ago to join the coordination of Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign. His responsibility is managing the candidate’s agenda in partnership with former minister Gilberto Carvalho, replicating the 2022 model.

item.title: “Putin agradece a Lula por esforços de paz na Ucrânia”
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin thanked Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for Brazil's diplomatic efforts to mediate peace in Ukraine during a phone call on August 4. The leaders affirmed convergence on key global agenda items and discussed strengthening bilateral relations in strategic sectors.

item.title: Pente-fino de Bolsa Família e BPC fica para depois das eleições
item.description: The Lula government postponed the biometric requirement for Bolsa Família until December 31, 2026, after the elections, and suspended the automatic termination of benefits for single-person households lacking home visits until July 2027. The move avoids cutting benefits just before the 2026 election rounds, though no public evidence of electoral motivation exists.

item.title: TSE divulga distribuição do tempo de propaganda eleitoral gratuita para as Eleições 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) released the party and federation representativity table for allocating free electoral advertising time on radio and TV and participation in debates for the 2026 elections. The União Progressista Federation (União Brasil and PP) leads with 104 federal deputies, followed by the PL (98) and the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB and PV) with 81. The criteria are based on Constitutional Amendment No. 97/2017 and TSE Resolutions No. 23.610/2019 and 23.671/2021.

item.title: Polícia Civil investiga suspeitos de planejar ataques durante eleições no Brasil
item.description: The Civil Police of the Federal District launched an operation on Tuesday (4) to investigate suspects allegedly planning attacks in Brasília during the October municipal elections. The action aims to assess threats to the security of the electoral process in the federal capital.

item.title: Flávio promete voucher para acesso a creche e “tratar internet como infraestrutura”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, pledged to implement a voucher system for daycare access, treat internet as infrastructure, and launch a program to help young people start businesses. The remarks were made during a sabatina with O Antagonista and G4.
